question: What permanent inbound message-size limit should the bundled QQBot gateway enforce before this PR merges?
rationale: The factory is the correct enforcement boundary, but source, QQ documentation, and loopback proof do not establish that every legitimate production event fits below 1 MiB; this compatibility-versus-resource-boundary choice requires QQBot owner intent.

options.title: Use a conservative 16 MiB cap
options.body: Match the proven Discord gateway scale, retaining a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default while lowering the chance of rejecting legitimate QQ events.

options.title: Approve the proposed 1 MiB cap
options.body: Merge the tighter boundary only if the QQBot owner accepts disconnecting any event above 1 MiB and considers the existing protocol and loopback evidence sufficient.

options.title: Wait for live size evidence
options.body: Pause until a credentialed QQBot run or authoritative platform contract establishes the largest legitimate event and then choose a measured margin.

recommendation.title: Use a conservative 16 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Match the proven Discord gateway scale, retaining a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default while lowering the chance of rejecting legitimate QQ events.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged QQBot gateway architecture work is the strongest current-main ownership signal for deciding the channel's receive-size contract.
